The '''Crypt of Martyrs''' was a burial site for martyrs that was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lorrd/Legends|Lorrd]].

==Description==
The Crypt was located in [[Qatamer]] on Lorrd and was considered by the [[Lorrdian/Legends|Lorrdians]] to be one of their most historically important sites. Lorrdians who had given their lives to fighting [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]] had their bodies interred in the Crypt and each tomb had a small [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]], which played recordings of the dead. The [[Jemas brothers]], the [[Kessel revolts]], the [[Serter Market Rebellions]] and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Mari-Elan Nora]] all had memorials insided the Crypt.

==History==
In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Tash Arranda/Legends|Tash Arranda]] visited the Crypt of Martyrs while on Lorrd and was eager to see the grave of Mari-Elan Nora.
